findings.evidence: Design Section 3.2 correction 5: "scripts/smoke-temp-bundle.mjs pins no tools/list result — its tool assertion is the four-name TOOL_DEFINITIONS durable-contract pin (~lines 77-82), which survives retirement unchanged". Section 4.1 states "project-error schema loses the staged-request kinds" and Section 3.2 correction 6 retires the STAGED_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND/STAGED_REQUEST_MISMATCH next-actions. In the checkout, scripts/smoke-temp-bundle.mjs:67 asserts `Object.keys(contracts.PROJECT_ERROR_DEFINITIONS).length === 55` and test/unit/errors.test.ts:9 asserts the same count; both codes are defined at src/contracts/errors.ts:95-96. Deleting them drops the count to 53, so `npm run build:temp` (Section 9) and `npm test` fail until both counts are updated, even though the design names smoke-temp-bundle as untouched and does not list test/unit/errors.test.ts in Section 5.3.
findings.suggested_resolution: Amend Section 3.2 correction 5 to note that only smoke-temp-bundle.mjs's TOOL_DEFINITIONS pin survives unchanged, and add its error-count pin (line 67) plus test/unit/errors.test.ts's count assertion to the Section 5.2/5.3 edit list — or state explicitly that the two staged-request error definitions are retained as durable history (like TOOL_NAMES) and only their next-actions and advertisement change.
findings.summary: Section 3.2 correction 5 claims scripts/smoke-temp-bundle.mjs needs no change, but that script also pins the project-error definition count, which the planned removal of the two staged-request error kinds invalidates.
